# Inspecto LA — demo script

<!-- generated by tools/render-product-docs.mjs from products/la.toon and the hubs it links; never edit it: change the definition or those hubs, then run the tool -->

*Audience: presales and whoever runs a live demo. Product Map Item [`product.la`](index.md) · a Domain product.*

## Before you start

Run the **demo** Distribution: it signs people in as Demo Users with no password, on 127.0.0.1 only, over synthetic data. Never give it to a customer or use it with real data. The Space `la-showcase` is pre-installed with its seeded state; the presenter text `products/la.demo-build.txt` ships in the bundle.

1. Run `bin\serve-demo.bat` (Windows) or `bin/serve-demo.sh` (Linux), then open http://127.0.0.1:8080.
2. Pick a Demo User on the sign-in page (below).

## Demo Users

| Sign in as | Name | What they show |
|---|---|---|
| `fm.analyst` | Demo FM Analyst | Fraud analyst (lead): owns mule-hub-case; works Investigations, Alert Rules and Incidents |
| `fm.manager` | Demo FM Manager | Fraud manager: the second approver of four-eyes requests; the Case is assigned to this user |
| `admin` | Demo Admin | Platform administrator: lead on the Investigation; can Reveal masked values and change LA settings |
| `ra.analyst` | Demo RA Analyst | Revenue Assurance reviewer: a member of the Investigation with no capability (view only) |
| `demo.manager` | Demo Manager | NOT a member of the Investigation: shows what a non-member sees (refused) |

## The walk-through

Open on the sign-in page: **Follow every link, one case at a time.**

### 1. [Link Analysis](../../app/link-analysis/index.md)

- **Link Analysis** — Investigate how entities link, one expand step at a time.
- **Data** — Your Datasets: add files, see what arrived, and choose how each is read as a graph.
- **Geo** — Place entities and routes on a map, over any Dataset with coordinates.
- **Entities** — See what the data says about each Entity Type and each Entity: how many, where, how fresh.
- **Entity Lists** — Keep watch lists of entities, with every change on the record.
- **Alerts** — See fired Alerts, and open the Investigation behind a standing detection.

## The seeded Alerts

The Alert Rules the demo Space holds: those its Space Templates ship and those the demo's seed adds. Show what they raised under **Alerts**.

| Alert Rule | Severity | From | What it finds |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mule-pass-through` | CRITICAL | the seed | Added by the demo's seed (`tools/seed-la-showcase.mjs`). |
| `telecom_irsf_lines` | CRITICAL | [Link Analysis showcase](../../solution-pack/la-showcase/index.md) | IRSF: lines sending 80 % or more of their calls to premium international numbers, averaging 10 minutes or more |
| `telecom_simbox_lines` | CRITICAL | [Link Analysis showcase](../../solution-pack/la-showcase/index.md) | SIM box: lines rotating across 3 or more handsets shared with 3 or more lines, making 50 times more calls than they receive |
| `telecom_wangiri_lines` | WARNING | [Link Analysis showcase](../../solution-pack/la-showcase/index.md) | Wangiri: lines ringing 50 or more numbers with an average call under 5 seconds |

## Close

Say the tagline: *Find the links between entities in your data: explore them as a graph, place them on a map, and keep lists of the ones that matter.*

Editions: [Basic](../../edition/basic/index.md) · [Standard](../../edition/standard/index.md) · [Advanced](../../edition/advanced/index.md) · [Preview](../../edition/preview/index.md). Distributions: production, trial, demo, pilot. The [datasheet](features.md) says which Apps each Edition can carry.

## Reset

Stop the server, delete .\spaces\la-showcase, and restore that folder from the zip (re-extract spaces\la-showcase). Anything done during a session (new steps, Drafts, Alert Rules) lives in that folder, so a reset discards it.
